title: Files — pluggable upload + URL resolver with storage-adapter contract
description: Host-pluggable file upload + URL resolution. Ships <FileUploadButton>, <FileChip>, useFileUpload(), useFileUrl() — all reading from a FilesAdapter the host wires via <FilesAdapterProvider>. Bundled localStorage demo adapter stores blobs as data URLs (small files only). Drop in your own adapter for Convex / S3 / GCS / R2. Zero backend coupling — the storage-adapter pattern reference for the blocked-pending-adapter wave.
